title: A Language for Christmas
subtitle: Origins
teaser: A bored researcher, a Christmas holiday, and a teaching language nobody wanted — plus the most consequential lock in programming history, added without a fight.

title: The Web Arrives
teaser: The dot-com boom turns a scripting language into a server language — and quietly plants both seeds of the concurrency war.

title: The Free Lunch Is Over
teaser: The concurrency crisis. The GIL becomes the villain; the community routes around it twice.

title: The Accidental Gift
subtitle: The Science Invasion
teaser: The GIL pushed compute into C — and the C ecosystem is exactly why science chose Python. The flaw causes the win.

title: Two Pythons
subtitle: The Schism
teaser: Guido breaks the world over strings. It takes twelve years, two economic crises, and a peace-offering u'' to put it back together.

title: Scripts Become Systems
teaser: Dropbox and Instagram hit millions of lines of untyped Python, Node steals the async crown, and the language grows types and await in self-defense.

title: The Abdication
teaser: A two-character operator triggers a succession crisis. The purest primary-source episode: the resignation email, timestamped.

title: The Lock Comes Off
subtitle: AI Coronation & the Speed Reckoning
teaser: The ecosystem the GIL accidentally created comes back to remove it. Full circle; roll credits.
